title: AnitoSetupState
description: Tracks which setup steps have been applied in this project. Lives at .anito/setup-state.json in the consuming repo. Committed to git.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this schema. Used by Anito to detect when migrations are needed.

anitoBinaryVersion.description: Version of the Anito binary that last ran setup.

projectName.description: Name of this project. Matches the name used in service configs.

lastSetupAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last setup run.

bootstrapped.description: True if this state file was synthesized from an existing .anito/config.yaml rather than recorded during a real first-run setup. Signals that appliedAt timestamps and anitoBinaryVersion may be approximate. Anito treats bootstrapped state files with extra caution — it will not overwrite existing config without confirmation.

appliedSteps.description: Ordered list of setup steps that have been applied to this project.

id.description: Stable identifier for this setup step. Never changes between schema versions.

stepVersion.description: Schema version in which this step was introduced.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what this step did.

appliedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this step was applied.

data.description: Step-specific data captured at setup time. Shape varies by step ID.
